Aladin Lite 3.9.2-beta

SPHEREx Discovery uses Aladin Lite for its sky-context viewer. Aladin Lite
is developed by the Centre de Données astronomiques de Strasbourg (CDS).
The upstream package credits Thomas Boch and Matthieu Baumann.
